channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Canada, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Canada, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 17 Aug 2026 (17 Aug to 23 Aug 2026).

  • Canada Council for the Arts: Arts Across Canada and Abroad, Circulation and Touring (October 2026 round)
    https://canadacouncil.ca/funding/grants/arts-across-canada-and-abroad
    Canada Council for the Arts · deadline 07 Oct 2026 · CAD. Minimum and maximum are NOT published publicly; amounts are disclosed only inside the Council's client portal at arts-services.ca, which requires a login. No application fee. Council funds cannot cover expenses already covered by another revenue source, and combined municipal, provincial and federal grants must demonstrate complementarity of public support.
  • Canada Council for the Arts: Arts Across Canada and Abroad, Public Outreach (October 2026 round)
    https://canadacouncil.ca/funding/grants/arts-across-canada-and-abroad
    Canada Council for the Arts · deadline 14 Oct 2026 · CAD. Minimum and maximum are NOT published publicly; disclosed only in the client portal at arts-services.ca, which requires a login. No application fee. Council funds cannot cover expenses already covered by another revenue source; combined public grants must demonstrate complementarity.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 06 Jul 2026 (06 Jul to 12 Jul 2026).

  • Inside Out RE:Focus Fund Post-Production Grants 2026
    https://insideout.ca/initiatives/re-focus-fund/
    Inside Out (Toronto 2SLGBTQ+ Film Festival) · deadline Closed 22 Jul 2026 · Post-production grant funding to support the completion and promotion of short and feature films; the requested amount is set by the applicant (see the FAQ 'How much funding can I request?'). Since 2018 the RE:Focus Fund has distributed more than CAD 300,000 in grants and programs. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 29 Jun 2026 (29 Jun to 05 Jul 2026).

  • Call to Artists: Walden Fire Station and Library (Calgary Arts Development)
    https://calgaryartsdevelopment.com/public-art/opportunities/all/call-to-artists-walden-fire-station-and-library/
    Calgary Arts Development (CADA) · deadline Closed 28 Jul 2026 · Total project budget of CAD 275,000 (exclusive of all applicable taxes) for one selected artist/artist team. The artist fee for the total project is CAD 68,750 + GST. Budget breakdown can be adapted to the artist's approach, following CARFAC's recommendation that a minimum 20% of the budget go to the artist's fee; the total allocated budget will not be increased.
